qualification_scope: llm_agent control plane plus pinned agent-dev-kit component
purpose: Separate engineering readiness from long-term terminal qualification while treating Digital Worker periodic R2 as an external nonblocking observation rather than a second llm_agent decision authority.

iteration_readiness.meaning: Development, integration and control-plane operation are ready. Digital Worker owns periodic R2 qualification; llm_agent observes it without re-certification. Only real longitudinal LTA-04 evidence remains a llm_agent terminal requirement.

maintainer_model.policy: Solo maintenance is an explicit operating model, not a waiver of automated governance, recovery, portability, or evidence requirements.

llm_agent.policy: The root repository is an operational control-plane workspace; durable component releases belong to versioned components such as agent-dev-kit.

agent_dev_kit.note: ADK lifecycle classification is stable here; current component version/commit/tree are owned exclusively by adk.lock and the signed promotion evidence chain. Digital Worker periodic R2 is a delegated nonblocking observation; LTA-04 is the only remaining llm_agent qualification requirement.

ADK native governance, strict stale-base rejection/requalification, exact-head merge, fresh-main qualification, keyless GitHub OIDC promotion, branch GC, and issue closure are terminally complete. LTA-02 and LTA-04 remain separate qualification requirements.

qualification_layers.note: Runtime replaceability qualification authority is Digital Worker. llm_agent retains runtime health/evolution observation only.

qualification_requirements.name: native-repository-governance
qualification_requirements.acceptance: A native repository ruleset covers main, requires pull requests, preserves the solo-maintainer zero-approval policy, has no unconditional bypass actors, permits squash merges only, requires the canonical stable PR qualification contexts with strict/up-to-date status enforcement, blocks destructive/non-fast-forward main updates, and delegates ordinary merged-PR branch deletion to native delete-on-merge while custom Branch GC is restricted to explicit exact-SHA retirement proofs.
completed_subrequirements: merged PR branch deletion observed before custom GC deletion
generic merged-PR custom GC responsibility retired

qualification_requirements.name: multi-runtime-portability-observation
qualification_requirements.acceptance: Digital Worker owns periodic R2 qualification. llm_agent may observe a fresh Digital Worker qualification receipt for runtime-practice analysis but must not re-certify provider evidence or make R2 a llm_agent terminal blocker.

qualification_requirements.name: solo-maintainer-recovery-drill
qualification_requirements.acceptance: A clean environment reconstructs the control plane from authoritative source, verifies current identities, exercises rollback/recovery, and emits a machine-readable receipt without relying on untracked local state.

qualification_requirements.name: longitudinal-operation
qualification_requirements.acceptance: At least 30 days of independent pilot observation are summarized with incidents, regressions, recovery events, and unresolved risks represented explicitly. Zero observed incidents/regressions/recoveries are valid only when represented explicitly; unresolved risks or a review hold keep terminal qualification pending.

terminal_readiness.meaning: Engineering and integration are ready. Digital Worker periodic R2 is observed but nonblocking here. LTA-04 real longitudinal evidence is the only remaining llm_agent terminal qualification requirement.

rehearsal_policy.purpose: Exercise the LTA-04 >=30-day PASS path with isolated time-travel fixtures without creating terminal qualification evidence.

longitudinal.claim: LTA-04 >=30-day certifier PASS path is reachable with isolated time-travel fixture evidence only.
